products.description:
The CAMILLE bag, the newest addition to the 16 soft line, a hobo shape with a functional design embodies the quintessence of the CELINE spirit.

Its refined calfskin leather combines suppleness with a soft touch and shiny finish. The reversed construction with piping, distinctive of CELINE’s leathergood craftsmanship, further accentuates its round hand.Its structured cut is borrowed from the 16 soft tote bag and gives it a sophisticated and singular appearance. The leather flap folds in line with the house’s gold finish iconic turnlock closure, shaped like a discreet jewel.

The CAMILLE 16 soft versatility is expressed through a short handle, allowing an elegant and refined shoulder carry whereas a longer adjustable handle allows a more casual and effortless crossbody carry. The two removable straps can be fixed and worn together or separately using CELINE engraved hooks.

For its first season, The CELINE 16 soft comes in a medium size, in black, tan and sand leather. A smaller version is available in black, tan and rice leather, as well as natural python.
